purpose: Separate historically examined third-party engineering work from independently reproduced V.A. system evidence. Nonpublic underlying carriers are NOT evidence on this public site.

admissionClasses.EXTERNAL_SUBMISSION_UNRELEASED: Historical external source and disposition retained under restricted custody; original bytes not published and no source standing inherited.
admissionClasses.PUBLIC_THIRD_PARTY_CARRIER: Release-cleared immutable external source and source identity linked; this is source evidence, not native V.A. evidence.
admissionClasses.BOUNDED_EXTERNAL_REVIEW: Qualified reviewer examination, tests, original receipts and a scope-limited disposition publicly attached; may have HOLD outcomes.
admissionClasses.INDEPENDENT_NATIVE_VA_REPRODUCTION: Separate actual native V.A. test by independently qualified external witness, original results and valid permission; cannot inherit from testing the submitter's own unrelated system.

publicReviewCandidates.note: Custody-ledger placeholder for a historically recorded external-submitted frozen technical examination. No external identity, private file hashes or results are disclosed; cannot be used as public proof. Retain any passes, failures, corrections and unresolved standing in the source review.

prohibitedInference: Historical third-party engineering test passes are not independent reproduction of protected native V.A., nor proof that the third-party implementation holds at the consequence boundary. Preserve narrower outcomes and HOLD dispositions.
futureAdmission: After all owners authorize a public extract, bind original bytes, SHA-256, reviewer identity/role/independence, scope, signed disposition, negative controls, route coverage and replay. Never rewrite the older original.
